title: Together AI serverless prompt samples exposed through repository credential
summary: Together AI confirmed on November 21 that an exposed credential committed by an AI coding agent to a public repository enabled an unauthorized party to download prompt samples from a private Hugging Face repository. The samples came from selected June and July 2026 inference requests; scope and personal data exposure remain under investigation.

rootCause.summary: An AI coding agent committed a private Hugging Face repository credential to a public code repository, enabling unauthorized download of stored prompt samples.

history.summary: Together AI disclosed historical prompt sample theft affecting selected June and July requests and ongoing forensic review. It reports tightened credential controls, pull-request scanning and ZDR defaults for new accounts.
